scope.summary: Implement the GPU-required render kinds that degrade to a determinate EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE state when no backend is present: Lighting Effects (point/spot/infinite lights, per-light properties, grayscale texture channels as bump maps), Flame (parameterized flames along a selected work path onto a pixel layer), Picture Frame (scripted decorative frame around canvas), Tree (parameterized species with leaf/branch/light settings). Real-GPU proof + headless fallback; each declares GPU dependency in its StudioLiveFilter descriptor.
acceptance_criteria: Lighting Effects, Flame, Picture Frame, Tree; GPU-required with declared dep + headless determinate unavailable state
expected_tests: real-GPU: Lighting Effects + Flame(path) + Picture Frame + Tree render
headless: EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE + descriptor declares GPU dep
test: Flame requires active work path; Picture Frame/Tree require pixel layer

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: GPU render workspace effects missing or silently empty headless.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
